name: Sanjō (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Sanjō city emblem in white: an outlined ring of concentric lines enclosing the character 條.
history: Municipal flag of Sanjō, a city in Niigata Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 4 October 2005.

features.role: Sanjō city emblem — an outlined ring of concentric lines enclosing the character 條
